notes.title: Magical Girl Dash have same big updates prepared for you!
notes.content:
Magical Girl Dash have same big updates prepared for you! The bakery have been completely reworked and now you can see a small intro that gives some context. This patch does not fix many bugs nor gives too much changes to the gamplay, but I believe these are really important additions to the game that gives more emotion, expression and context.


[list]
[*]Bakery: Now instead of a static scenario with an art that doesn't fit too well with the rest of the game you now can visit and interact with the Grumpy Bear Cafe. You can see the sweets you collected, customers appearing and you can talk with Yuzu, the clerk and owner of the cafe. So far the customers and sweets are static and you can't talk, but maybe this will change in the future.

[*]Intro: When starting the game you can watch a small intro. This is important to give some context to the game and players won't feel lost not understanding what is happening and what is the objective.
[/list]



In the near future I have a really interesting update prepared: the addition of other magical girls!

This is it for now. I hope you enjoyed!

notes.title: Bug Fix Patch - 1.0.2
notes.content:
A new bug fix patch (with a few additions) is here! Here is what changed:

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the Highscore didn't open when clicked.
[*]Fixed a bug with fullscreen behaving weirdly.
[*]Fixed a bug where resolutions dropdown on settings wasn't showing anything.
[*]Fixed a bug where the black hole wasn't appearing.

[/list]

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a mid boss.
[*]Adjustments to the boss battle. (now other enemies will not appear while fighting a boss or mid boss)
[*]Adjustments to level progression.
[*]Now the powerup effects are shown before starting a new game.
[/list]

notes.title: Post Launch Bug Fix Patch - 1.0.1
notes.content:
First of all, thank you for buying Magical Girl Dash on its release! I'm really glad the game is being well received and I'm grateful to all comments of players enjoying the game and suggesting improvements and ideas. Now let's go to what matters.

A few bugs have already been reported and this is the first bug fix patch released. Here is the complete list:

[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] ✔️ Fixed a bug where the girl in the bakery always said the same things no matter how many sweets you had.
[*] ✔️ Fixed a bug of the Loading Screen being displayed weirdly.
[*] ✔️ Adjusted the diffilculty of the boss.
[*] ✔️ Adjusted the time the boss appear.
[*] ✔️ Changed the transformation animation appearing every time you start a new run. Now it will appear only once when you start a new game from the home screen.
[/list]

[h2]Known Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] ❌ There is a bug where the resolution options don't appear on the settings menu.
[*] ❌ Some achievements not displaying correctly.
[*] ❌ Language settings not working for some players.
[*] ❌ Settings configurations sometimes not saving new information.
[/list]


Aside from bug fixed I also listened to some of the constructive criticism and changed a few things:

[list]
[*] Two new enemie added, Chunky Cat and Black Hole, to increase variety and difficulty of the game.
[*] Now you lose your powerups when receiving damage to make the game more interesting and challenging.
[*] Now enemies drop stolen sweets instead of they appearing randomly on the level. 
[*] The large shot powerup now deal increased damaged against enemies with bigger health, like the UFO cat and chuky cat.
[/list]
